description: Registered parent HTTP resource mounted at /parent with production ParentSessionChain, real owner capabilities (Care Plan plans, exceptions, pickups, status days and requests, Student Presence attendance, the sharing ledger with Familienschutz, batch settings, meal plan) and tenant/admin transactions. Two schools; the first grows from one to three children with positive data, the second keeps one child. Per request: one administrative child read, then per school one settings snapshot, one meal-switch transaction, one tenant transaction for shares, Familienschutz and open requests, and one for the day (status days, attendance, attendance culture, exceptions, weekly plans, pickups). The count is the same for one and three children of a school. Captures every request-scoped SQL statement; excludes fixture setup/signing and outer production server/live-session middleware.
